 Jordan Ellis Sat 14 November 2026 19:24 Follow us on Google Discover Long-time bantamweight contender Macy Chiasson appears to be done with MMA. 
 The 35-year-old attempted to snap a run of three successive decision defeats at UFC 334 on Saturday night. 
 Macy Chiasson ‘s losing streak was extended to four as she was submitted in the first round by 9-0 rising star Bia Mesquita at Madison Square Garden in New York.

 Macy Chiasson issued a social media statement in the immediate aftermath of her first-round defeat at UFC 334.
 The 10-7 veteran suggested she will retire after tapping out to Bia Mesquita’s rear-naked choke.
 “One of the best camps I’ve ever had,” Chiasson wrote on her Instagram Story .
 Impresionante ‼️
Clase maestra para lograr una finalización en el primer round 😱
#Polymarket #UFC334 | Estamos en vivo por @PPlusDeportes https://t.co/0mB0BsP3PG
— UFC Español (@UFCEspanol) November 14, 2026 View Tweet “Pretty sure I’m done fighting.
 “Thank you to everyone for the support and the UFC for an awesome time.
 “Really love this sport and everything it’s done for me in my life. 
 “Super grateful for everything and everyone I’ve met along the way.
 “All love.”
 If this is the end, Chiasson will walk away with eight wins and seven losses as a UFC fighter.
 The Ultimate Fighter 28 winner holds high-profile victories over Gina Mazany, Marion Reneau, and Norma Dumont. 
 Chiasson also shared the Octagon with Raquel Pennington, Irene Aldana , Ketlen Vieira, and Ailin Perez .
